description.narrative:
LUIGI description Since its inception, the Luigi Giussani Institute for Higher Education (LGIHE) has focused on education as a toolto help youth recover their identity, self-worth, and sense of belonging. The discovery of the self is the first step in the discovery of reality as whole. It is the special responsibility of the educator to nurture this process of discovery in children and to help learners become protagonists who thrive as responsible adults. From LGIHE’s experience, it became evident that the Ugandan education system is not capable of retaining learners in schools and endowing them with the necessary skills for facing life and for decent employability. For this reason, in the past 8 years LGIHE focused its attention the life skills (character skills, soft skills) development at various levels and assessment of these skills. LGIHE has over the years positioned itself in the path of facilitating and supporting provision of quality education by strategically seeking and establishing relevant partnerships and networks that can support this process. We have since 2007 been partnering with UNEB, Teacher/Tutor Instructor and Education Training department (TIET), and other departments of the Ministry of Education and Sports, contributing to improved Teacher Education curricula with a resultant effect on improved learning outcomes for students in 29 districts of Uganda.
VISION To be a leading institution of higher learning that has a transformative impact on society in Uganda and throughout Africa by improving the quality of education and professional development.
MISSION To create opportunities for professional and personal development starting with the dignity and infinite value of the person, developing one’s methods of personal engagement and the meaning of work, targeting teachers, students, parents andother professionals.
VALUES We are guided by a set of complementary values that are fundamental to the institute’s identity and provide the foundation for its practices
RELI’slong-term goal is to empower its members to become effective and influential organizations capable of influencing policies and practices towards improved learning outcomes across the region.
The three specific objectives of RELI revolve around bettercoordination <(>&<)>amp; alignment, increased member capacity and policy influence for improved learning outcomes Contribution LGIHE will play the role of lead of the education component of the project. It will be in charge of developing new curricula and training facilitators and instructors on new pedagogical skills, entrepreneurial skills, soft skills, and green skills. LGIHE will be also collaborating with the local VTIs and the national Directorate

participating-org.narrative:
Luigi Giussani Institute of Higher Education (LGIHE) was founded by Rose Busingye, Founder and President of Meeting Point International (MPI) and Dr. George William Pariyo, a renowned Scientific Researcher with the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. Our educational journey started with a simple dialogue among 5 friends in Uganda whose discussion mainly entailed education challenges that we recurring in the country by then and possible ways on how to address them. As a result, professional development trainings were born that culminated into the official registration of the institute in 2009.
With a need to grow further, coupled with a high demand from teachers to offer academic programmes that could enable them advance in their vocation, Luigi Giussani Institute of Higher Education (LGIHE) obtained accreditation as an institution of higher learning by the National Council for Higher Education. 2. ACHIEVEMENTS What have been the principal results in the past three years that contribute to significant, structural, sustained and positive improvement in the lives of men, women, girls and boys suffering from poverty, injustice, insecurity and exclusion?
Highly competent staff were hired, trained and increasingly involved in project development, quality improvement and outreach. Four education officers (facilitators) and one Monitoring and Evaluation (M<(>&<)>E) officer were hired. This improved the quality of services offered. # The evaluation of our basic teacher training package was carried out with a rigorous methodology (control group difference in difference comparison) in collaboration with a top US university (Notre Dame University) and utilizing both quantitative andqualitative expertise and methodologies. Major findings of the study - An increase in the quality of teacher-pupil relationship (trust): The assessment found out that the LGIHE trainings enhance teachers# awareness about the importance of a friendlier, familiar and open relationship between teachers and students whichenables learners to participate freely in class. - An enhanced awareness amongst the teachers that learners have innate desires and abilities - A change of attitude towards teaching that affirms that is more of a discovery moment in which the learners are at the centre of the educational process, and play a pro-active role. - An increasedawareness of child development as related to teaching especially among the teachers that received the full and light program. - A reduction in violent discipline especially from the students# view: The qualitative research revealed positive examples of teachers and head teachers changing their perception on appropriate methods of discipline other than using physical punishment. - An increasedlearners# perception that teachers use collaborative and active learning methods: The qualitative analysis reveals how teachers aremore willing to give learners more chances to ask questions, participate and contribute their own ideas in class. - An increased conviction of education as communication of an approach to life. Teachers now show understanding of the comprehensive value of education in both urban and rural settings. - An increased collaboration among teachers: The qualitative research found that some teachers andhead teachers sometimes reflect on the content of LGIHE#s workshops as a way to improve their daily activities and try to build amore #familiar# environment. Positive changes in teachers/head teachers# behaviour toward their own families. One of the most interesting findings of the research was that the workshops have introduced a new modality of relationship between teachers/head teachersand their own families. # The institute made important improvements to the existing set of courses offered. The institute redefinedand improved on the existing short re-training courses. Past experience underscored the importance of developing the teachers# awareness of their role, and the meaning of education. A new continuous professional development training coursewas improved and furtherdeveloped with the specific aim of improving on teachers# pedagogical approach (basic pedagogy, taxonomy of learning objectives andpositive discipline) and didactic approach (lesson planning, creativity in teaching, teaching methodologies, use of monitoring instruments). The institute also further refined the complementary support to training workshops, which includes classroom observations and teachers# coaching sessions with the help of a comprehensive monitoring tool which wasdeveloped in the course of the project. # The institute was recognized by the Ministry of Education and Sports (MoES), through the National Council for Higher Education (NCHE), as an institute of higher education, with the new name, Luigi Giussani Institute of Higher Education (LGIHE). # A thorough financial and operational capacity analysis was carried out by an external consultant, resulting in a sophisticated guide to long-term planning by the institute .
3. INSTITUTIONAL PURPOSE The Vision: LGIHE#s vision is to improve the quality of education and professional development by being a leading institution of higher education with a transformative impact on society in Uganda and throughout Africa. Mission Statement: LGIHE#s mission is to createopportunities for professional and personal development, which starts from thedignity and infinite value of the person and are developed through a method of personal engagement with one#s life and the meaning of one#s work, targeting teachers, other professionals, parents and students. Mission: What is the current purpose of the organisation? To offer academic programmes and continuous professional development trainings that contribute to quality education which positively transforms an individual. Institutional objectives: What are the principal changes the organisation seeks to achieve over the long term? a) Becoming the leading training institution in performance improvement coaching and mentoring in Uganda, given our uniqueinteractive methodswithstudents.
b) Introducing all our students to the appreciation of the value of the human being and human dignity through different courses taught by the institution. c) Equipping students with state of the art knowledge, skills, values and attitudesindifferent disciplines necessary for their present and future work as educators, business men or even managers of the burgeoning corporate world. d) Nurturing genuine professionals who are uniquely prepared to offer authentic companionship to studentsandother forms of clients.
